# 1 Samuel Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 155r-155v | **Source Image:** 1SA_010_page_001.jpg, 1SA_010_page_002.jpg

---

**10:1** And-took Samuel the-flask of-the-oil and-poured [it] upon his-head and-kissed him and-said, "Has-not YHWH anointed-you over his-inheritance [as] leader [nagid]?

**10:2** When-you-go today from-with-me, then-you-will-find two men by-[the]-tomb of-Rachel in-[the]-territory of-Benjamin at-Zelzah, and-they-will-say to-you, 'The-donkeys have-been-found which you-went to-seek, and-behold, your-father has-abandoned the-matter of-the-donkeys and-is-anxious about-you, saying, "What shall-I-do about-my-son?"'

**10:3** And-you-will-pass-on from-there and-further and-come to-[the]-oak of-Tabor, and-there shall-find you three men going-up to God at-Beth-el: one carrying three young-goats, and-one carrying three loaves of-bread, and-one carrying a-skin of-wine.

**10:4** And-they-will-ask of-your-welfare and-give to-you two [loaves of]-bread, and-you-shall-receive from-their-hand.

**10:5** After that you-will-come to-Gibeah of-God [Giv'at ha-Elohim], where [is] the-garrison of-[the]-Philistines. And-it-will-be, when-you-come there to-the-city, that-you-will-meet a-band of-prophets coming-down from-the-high-place, and-before-them [a] harp and-[a] tambourine and-[a] flute and-[a] lyre, and-they [will be]-prophesying.

**10:6** And-shall-rush upon-you [the]-spirit of-YHWH, and-you-shall-prophesy with-them, and-you-shall-be-turned into-another man.

**10:7** And-it-will-be when-these signs come to-you, do for-yourself what your-hand finds, for God [is] with-you.

**10:8** And-you-shall-go-down before-me to-Gilgal, and-behold, I [am]-going-down to-you to-offer-up burnt-offerings, to-sacrifice sacrifices of-peace-offerings. Seven days you-shall-wait until I-come to-you, and-I-will-make-known to-you what you-shall-do."

**10:9** And-it-was when-he-turned his-shoulder to-go from-with Samuel, and-God turned for-him another heart, and-all these signs came on-that day.

**10:10** And-they-came there to-Gibeah, and-behold, a-band of-prophets [was coming] to-meet-him, and-rushed upon-him [the]-spirit of-God, and-he-prophesied in-their-midst.

**10:11** And-it-was, all [who]-knew him from-yesterday and-from-before-that, and-they-saw, and-behold, with-[the]-prophets he-prophesied. And-said the-people each to-his-neighbor, "What [is] this [that] has-happened to-[the]-son of-Kish? Is-also Saul among-the-prophets?"

**10:12** And-answered a-man from-there and-said, "And-who [is] their-father?" Therefore it-became a-proverb [mashal]: "Is-also Saul among-the-prophets?"

**10:13** And-he-finished from-prophesying and-came to-the-high-place.

**10:14** And-said [the]-uncle of-Saul to-him and-to his-servant, "Where did-you-go?" And-he-said, "To-seek the-donkeys. And-we-saw that-[they were]-not [there], and-we-came to-Samuel."

**10:15** And-said [the]-uncle of-Saul, "Tell me, please, what did-Samuel-say to-you?"

**10:16** And-said Saul to-his-uncle, "He-surely-told us that the-donkeys were-found." But-the-matter of-the-kingship [ha-melukah] he-did-not tell him, which Samuel had-said.

**10:17** And-Samuel called the-people to YHWH, to-Mizpah.

**10:18** And-he-said to-[the]-sons of-Israel, "Thus says YHWH, [the]-God of-Israel: 'I brought-up Israel from-Egypt, and-I-delivered you from-[the]-hand of-Egypt and-from-[the]-hand of-all the-kingdoms, the-[ones]-oppressing you.'

**10:19** But-you today have-rejected your-God, who himself [is]-your-savior from-all your-evils and-your-distresses, and-you-said to-him, 'No, but a-king you-shall-set over-us.' And-now present-yourselves before YHWH by-your-tribes and-by-your-thousands."

**10:20** And-Samuel brought-near all the-tribes of-Israel, and-was-taken [by lot] the-tribe of-Benjamin.

**10:21** And-he-brought-near the-tribe of-Benjamin by-its-clans, and-was-taken the-clan of-the-Matrites, and-was-taken Saul son of-Kish. And-they-sought him, but-he-was-not-found.

**10:22** And-they-inquired again of-YHWH, "Has the-man yet come here?" And-said YHWH, "Behold, he is-hiding himself among the-baggage [kelim]."

**10:23** And-they-ran and-took him from-there. And-he-stood-forth in-[the]-midst of-the-people, and-he-was-taller than-all the-people from-his-shoulder and-upward.

**10:24** And-said Samuel to-all the-people, "Do-you-see [him]-whom YHWH has-chosen, for-there-is-none like-him in-all the-people?" And-shouted all the-people and-said, "Long-live the-king!"

**10:25** And-spoke Samuel to-the-people the-manner [mishpat] of-the-kingship [ha-melukah] and-wrote [it] in-a-book [sefer] and-laid-it-up before YHWH. And-Samuel sent-away all the-people, each to-his-house.

**10:26** And-also Saul went to-his-house, to-Gibeah, and-went with-him the-valiant-ones [benei ha-chayil] whose hearts God had-touched.

**10:27** But-sons of-worthlessness [benei beliya'al] said, "How shall-this-one save-us?" And-they-despised him and-did-not bring to-him a-gift. But-he-was as-one-being-deaf."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **10:1 — "flask of oil"** (פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן): The *pak* is a small flask, distinct from the *shofar* horn used later for David's anointing (16:1,13). The diminutive vessel may hint at Saul's provisional status.

2. **10:5 — Giv'at ha-Elohim**: "Gibeah of God" — Saul's hometown, here identified as having a Philistine garrison. The juxtaposition of prophetic ecstasy and enemy occupation frames the political crisis.

3. **10:6 — "turned into another man"** (נֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר): The verb *n-h-p-k* is the same used for the overthrow of Sodom. EMET preserves the passive construction: Saul is *turned*, not turning himself.

4. **10:12 — "Who is their father?"**: A cryptic remark. The question suggests prophecy is not hereditary — the spirit falls on whom it will, regardless of lineage.

5. **10:22 — "among the baggage"** (בַּכֵּלִים): Saul hides among the supplies/equipment. This detail — the newly chosen king hiding from his own coronation — is one of the most psychologically complex moments in 1 Samuel.

6. **10:25 — mishpat ha-melukah**: The "manner/ordinance of the kingship" — Samuel writes a constitutional document and deposits it before YHWH. This is distinct from the *mishpat ha-melek* (manner of the king) in 8:11-18, which was a warning.

7. **10:27 — benei beliya'al**: "Sons of worthlessness" — the same epithet applied to Eli's sons (2:12). The term *beliya'al* may derive from *beli* (without) + *ya'al* (profit/worth).

— EMET
